fixed.explanation: Both load hooks transform and short-circuit any file:// module whose format is supported or undefined. Unknown extensions such as .mdx (format undefined) get read and transformed as JS, so later registered loaders never run. The fix defers to the next loader for extensions Playwright doesn't handle, in both the async and sync hooks.

input.intent: Playwright test runner's module loading hooks (ESM loader / require hook) that transform ts/js files and handle resolution; for file extensions it doesn't transform (e.g. .mdx), it should defer to the next registered Node.js loader/default load instead of bypassing it or failing.
input.symptom: Custom Node.js loaders registered for file types like MDX are bypassed by Playwright's ESM loader, so test collection fails.
